description: This file is a PHP configuration and integration script for a Redmine issue tracker. It sets up API keys, URLs, and project identifiers for different Redmine instances, and demonstrates creating an XML configuration snippet and invoking methods to interact with the Redmine API.

classes.name: tlIssueTracker
classes.description: A class presumably used to interact with issue trackers, instantiated with a database object.

classes.name: redminerestInterface
classes.description: A class used to communicate with Redmine's REST API, instantiated with a project ID and configuration string.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Method of tlIssueTracker to retrieve types of issues or categories.

methods.name: getCfg
methods.description: Method of redminerestInterface to retrieve the current configuration.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Method of redminerestInterface to add a new issue to Redmine.
